what_happened: The job "Make drain work in-limit proposals and approved-work jobs" ended failed. The producer's final report was sent back with problems still present. Two acceptance criteria were unmet or not reported. The first was that the module text in drain.rs must stop saying drain cannot approve a proposal, and must say in-limit proposals are approved and approved jobs are worked, with rejection and above-limit approval left to people. The second was that `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` pass. The event lists no blocker or major findings. Nothing was delivered.
cause: Completion is judged only once, when the producer's final report is checked against the criteria. Nothing requires the producer to map each criterion to evidence before reporting done. Nothing blocks the report until the build gate has run and its result is recorded. Two criteria are easy to skip: a doc-comment update, which has no failing test, and a check list that needs separate commands. Gaps surface at the end as a failed job. The same pattern appeared in the earlier steward-limit job. The criteria also list the check commands as an acceptance item, which mixes the two lists and makes it unclear who runs them and when.
prevention: Add a pre-report gate in code. The producer cannot submit a final report until (1) the workspace checks (cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets, cargo test) have been run by the harness on the current tree and the results recorded, and (2) the report contains an entry for every acceptance criterion with evidence, such as a file and line or a command result. If either is missing, the harness returns the report to the producer immediately, within the same job, instead of ending it failed. Stale doc text could also be caught by a cheap grep check where a criterion names a phrase that must be gone.
proposed_request: Make drain approve in-limit proposals and work approved jobs, and make sure its documentation matches. Outcome: the module text in drain.rs says in-limit proposals are approved and approved jobs are worked, and says rejecting and approving above-limit proposals stay with people. It no longer says drain cannot approve a proposal. Before reporting done, run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo test for the workspace and confirm they pass. In the final report, give evidence for each acceptance criterion, including the new drain.rs text and the check results.
